body.purpose: These are not marketing personas. They are production acceptance scenarios. The product should ultimately be able to satisfy all 50 without changing its fundamental architecture. If the system repeatedly forces the owner to perform administrative work described below, the relevant case has failed.

Nothing looks the company up from its tax number; the owner types name and number.
